snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 - Release Date Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115160/Warhammer_40000_Boltgun_2/

A release date trailer for Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2. The video also showcases a new villain and a music collaboration with Mick Gordon.  Play as Ultramarine Malum Caedo or Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath in this sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 
https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
